learning_outcomes.text: Geometrical quantities metrology (length, angle, Geometrical surface properties etc.

syllabus_topics: Metrology, basic concepts. Organization, sequence, legislation.
Length measures. Block of gauges, application, properties, calibration. Limit gauges. Measurement uncertainty.
Measurement in one coordinate. Length measuring machines.
Measurement in two coordinates. Microscopes, profilprojectores. Software.
Thread measuring, methods.
Angles measuring. Methods, instruments. Cones measuring.
Measurement in three coordinates. Coordinate measuring machines.
Laserinterferometers. Principle, application in length metrology.
Geometrical surface properties. Importance, concepts definition, measuring methods and evaluations.
Form deviation and deviations of positions (macrogeometry). Measuring methods and evaluations.
Surface texture (microgeometry). Evaluation, parameters, filtering, measurement methods, instruments.
Basis of the measurement automatisation.
Measurement process capability and MSA measurement system analysis. Sources of measurement variability.
Introduction to metrology. Labour protection. Length measuring. Statistical evaluation.
Length measures. Length measuring machines.
Measurement long dimensions. Calibration block of gauges.
Measurement in two coordinates. Microscopes.
Measurement in two coordinates. Profilprojectores.
Thread measuring.
Angles measuring. Angle gauge, squares, polygons, levels. Cones measuring.
Angles measuring. Optical dividing instruments.
Form - and position deviations. Measuring, evaluation.
Form - and position deviations. Measuring, evaluation.
Measurement in two coordinates. Microscopes and software M2D.
Measurement in three coordinates. Coordinate measuring machine.
Surface texture (microgeometry). Measuring and evaluation. Inclusion.
